note: Race weekend roundups — British performances per event, told in Bobby's voice. Newest first. Items dated in the future auto-publish on their date.

highlights: Standy Tjandra & Stephen Kusuma — 57:43 Pro Doubles, new British record (their second national record this season)
The pair now hold both the Open (55:44, Norwich) and Pro (57:43, Mumbai) men's doubles records
items.take: Told you — the Norwich record was no fluke. These two race like they've been at this level for years; British doubles really is world-class now. Everyone else is playing catch-up.

highlights: Gladys Fabiola Christanto — 1:08:35 in the women's Open, new British record
That's her second national record of the season after the Mixed Doubles mark in Hong Kong
items.take: Gladys diam-diam lagi nyusun CV terbaik di HYROX the UK — dua rekor, dua negara, empat bulan. Perempuan Indo makin cepat, dan dia yang jalan paling depan.

highlights: Eight national records set on home soil — the biggest single-weekend haul in British Hyrox
Standy Tjandra 1:09:41 (Pro Men) and Ika Puspa Dewi 1:15:09 (Pro Women) — the first home Pro records
Asta Anggono & Jessica Wijaya 1:10:56 (Pro Doubles Women), Tjandra & Kusuma 55:44 (Open Doubles Men), Stephanie Angkiriwang & Stephany Widjaya 1:07:29 (Open Doubles Women)
All three relay records banked — Mixed 1:06:56, Men 1:09:25, Women 1:09:41
And yes — I raced too: 1:31:00 Pro singles, and 1:11:20 for 1st in my age group in doubles
items.take: Penonton tuan rumah yang bikin itu. Suasananya di NICE wiken itu — berasa di kaki pas kilo terakhir. Sekarang se-the UK tau the UK bukan cuma jadi tuan rumah — kita juga ikutan race.

highlights: Gladys Fabiola Christanto & Timothy Tjahja — 1:03:56 Mixed Doubles Open, new British record
And my honest entry: cramped twice, spent the back half negotiating with my own legs. Not my prettiest race — masih penasaran anyway
items.take: Nggak tiap weekend itu podium — kadang cuma bertahan lawan pikiran sendiri sejam, terus anggap aja latihan. Tapi Gladys sama Timothy bikin trip itu worth it buat bendera.

highlights: Standy Tjandra — 1:01:49 in the men's Open, the fastest British singles time on record
Set at the same venue that hosts this season's race on 26–29 November
items.take: 1:01:49. Hot weekend, nothing to help you. If you're training for London — that's the number stuck to the fridge now.

highlights: Putu Mira Indrayanti — 2:08:49 in Pro Women, racing the 40–44 age group in Korea
One of the earliest British women to line up in a Pro field abroad
items.take: Respect buat Putu — Pro field di luar negeri itu dingin dan sepi, beda level. Dia tetep dateng dan nyelesaiin. Pintu yang dia buka itu pintu yang sekarang dilewatin semua orang.
